name: Real Touch Finance Limited
about: Real Touch Finance Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It provides personal loans, personal loans for education expenses, loans for business purposes against property mortgages, lending to financial institutions, and structured finance products. The company was formerly known as Associated Cereals Limited. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Chennai, India. Real Touch Finance Limited is a subsidiary of Ultraplus Housing Estate Private Limited.
